metadata.name: backstop
metadata.description: SAFU Credit: backer capital, wrongful-liquidation payouts, bad-debt cover

instructions.name: absorb_interest
docs: Recognises USDC `pay_backer_interest` has already moved into the pool's vault. Permissionless,
bounded by the unaccounted surplus actually sitting in the token account (2c pattern, in
reverse) -- a raw donation is never counted, and repeat calls settle only the remainder.

instructions.name: approve_override
docs: Admin or co-signer only. The 2-of-2 override (LOCKED verdict spec): each approver submits
the same `ref_at_liq` once; the second matching, current-key approval executes. Skips
checks (a)/(b)/(c) and the 60-day gate. Never skips: record + borrower match, the
issuer-action exclusion, one payout per liquidation (a `Completed` claim is refused), the
on-chain loss formula, the per-claim cap, or solvency — `ref_at_liq` is supplied, not the
loss itself, and the loss is still computed on-chain via `safu_core::wrongful_loss`, then
still run through `try_admit`'s cap/solvency logic exactly like an ordinary admission.
A prior `Active` claim's unstreamed reservation is released and its `streamed` carried
forward, so the correction can never pay out on top of what already streamed.

instructions.name: buy_inventory
docs: Buys collateral out of a market's inventory at the healthy price minus the discount, never
below the pool's own cost for the first `resale_floor_secs` after acquiring it, and never
while the price is flagged or a corporate-action hold is active (D5). Bounded by the
buyer's own `max_price_per_share` (slippage).

instructions.name: cancel_claim
docs: Admin-only. Cancels a held (`PendingTime`), `Queued`, or `Active` claim with a public
reason code (LOCKED verdict spec). An `Active` claim's unstreamed reservation is released
exactly as it would be on expiry. The 365-day no-coverage penalty applies only if real
money had actually left the pool for this claim (`streamed > 0`) — catching a mistake
before any payout moved costs the borrower nothing.

instructions.name: claim_stream
docs: Pulls whatever has vested and fits today's outflow cap to the claim's frozen payout ATA.
Permissionless — the payout address, not the caller, receives the funds.

instructions.name: cover_bad_debt
docs: Reimburses a lending market for debt its collateral could not cover. Permissionless.
What is owed is the market's own monotonic write-off total minus what this backstop has
already paid it, so repeat calls settle the remainder and never double-pay — no epochs to
keep in step. The USDC simply lands in the market's vault; the market recognises it through
its own `absorb_bad_debt_cover`, which is bounded by its outstanding bad debt.

accounts.name: market
docs: Owned by the lending vault program, so its bad-debt counter cannot be fabricated.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Backer capital in. Shares are priced off `config.cash`, never the token account balance, so
a raw transfer into the vault cannot move the share price.

instructions.name: expire_queued
docs: A `Queued` claim that never fit inside the claim window expires. It reserved nothing, so
nothing is released.

instructions.name: expire_stale
docs: An `Active` claim with no pull for its admitted `inactivity_secs` returns its unpaid remainder to
the backstop by simply un-reserving it — nothing was ever transferred for that remainder.

instructions.name: finalize_withdraw
docs: Takes the money out, bounded by `cash − reserved_total`: only the claim amount an `Active`
claim actually reserves is off-limits, not the whole pool while any claim merely exists
(queued or held claims reserve nothing until they are actually admitted).

instructions.name: initialize_backstop
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority may initialize, so nobody watching the deploy can call it
first and take admin. Initialize before any `--final`: a program with no upgrade authority can
never be initialized.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program. Proves `program_data` belongs to it, not to a program the caller deployed.

instructions.name: open_borrower_claims
docs: Opens the single-slot claim tracker for one (market, borrower) pair. Permissionless — anyone
may open it ahead of a borrower's first claim.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: is permissionless and holds no funds.

instructions.name: open_interest_absorbed
docs: Opens the interest-recognition counter for one market (phase 3). Permissionless, one-time.

instructions.name: open_inventory
docs: Opens the collateral-inventory tracker and its token vault for one market (phase 3).
Permissionless, one-time, ahead of that market's first pool liquidation.

instructions.name: open_override
docs: Permissionless. Opens the 2-of-2 override request for one liquidation, ahead of the first
`approve_override` call.

instructions.name: pool_liquidate
docs: Liquidates a position through the vault with the pool itself as liquidator
(backstop-as-liquidator lock). A permissionless crank; the caller pays the new
`LiquidationRecord`'s rent (A1 -- the pool's key is a program PDA, it cannot fund an
account) and earns a slice of the bonus (D6). Bounded by the per-liquidation and daily
caps -- over either, this pays what caps and cash allow (E1): the position stays
liquidatable and an outside liquidator may act once the vault's own grace period elapses.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the new LiquidationRecord's rent (A1) and receives the crank fee.

accounts.name: vault_config
docs: The vault's own config, required by the CPI; re-validated there, not here.

accounts.name: position
docs: against its own seeds, so a wrong position simply fails inside the CPI.

accounts.name: record
docs: vault's own seeds so a wrong address fails before the CPI runs, not inside it.

accounts.name: pool_usdc_vault
docs: The pool's own USDC -- doubles as the CPI's `liquidator_usdc`.

accounts.name: inventory_vault
docs: The pool's own collateral holding -- doubles as the CPI's `liquidator_collateral`.

instructions.name: request_withdraw
docs: Queues an exit. The delay exists so capital cannot leave in front of a verdict that is
already being prepared off-chain but not yet submitted.

instructions.name: revoke_attestation
docs: Admin-only. Marks one specific signed-but-not-yet-submitted attestation revoked, so a
leaked-oracle-key scenario has an on-chain block even before anyone tries to submit it.

instructions.name: set_admin
docs: Hands the admin role over (U5). No renounce path: an unowned backstop could never rotate a
leaked oracle key.

instructions.name: set_backstop_params
docs: Admin-settable within hard bounds (U2), so neither knob can be set somewhere unsafe: a zero
per-claim cap would freeze every admission, and an unbounded withdrawal delay would trap backers.

instructions.name: set_claim_timing
docs: Phase 5 (A5): sets every claim timing at once, bounded per cluster by `require_claim_timing`.
Forward-only: a held claim keeps the `releasable_at` it was given at submission, and an admitted
claim keeps the cooldown, stream and inactivity window it was admitted under.

instructions.name: set_co_signer
docs: Rotates the 2-of-2 override co-signer (phase 4). Same recoverability rationale as
`set_verdict_oracle`: a leaked co-signer key must be replaceable without a program upgrade.

instructions.name: set_pool_liquidation_params
docs: Pool-liquidation params, bounded (phase 3). A5's per-cluster floors land in phase 5; these are
generic ceilings only, so the demo can run fast today without leaving a mainnet admin free to
set anything unsafe later.

instructions.name: set_verdict_oracle
docs: Rotates the verdict oracle key (U5). It is a throwaway per-chain Ed25519 key, so a leak has
to be recoverable on-chain: without this, replacing it would need a program upgrade.
Claims already submitted stay valid; unsubmitted facts signed by the old key stop verifying.

instructions.name: submit_facts
docs: Records an oracle-signed facts payload for one liquidation and runs the verdict rules
on-chain (LOCKED verdict spec). The transaction must place the oracle's Ed25519 precompile
instruction directly before this one. Anyone may submit; the signature is the authorization.
A structurally invalid submission (bad signature, expired deadline, mismatched record,
issuer-halted liquidation, self-dealt liquidation, a privileged payout address, or a
borrower with an unresolved claim already open) reverts the transaction. A submission that
checks out structurally but fails the wrongfulness rules — the price wasn't actually wrong,
the move held, or the loss nets to zero — is recorded on-chain as `Denied` with a reason
code, rather than reverting: a claims decision must be visible, not silently dropped.

accounts.name: liquidation_record
docs: Owned by the lending vault program — Anchor's `Owner` check is what proves this record was
written by the vault and not fabricated.

accounts.name: existing_claim
docs: manually as a `Claim` owned by this program. Any account may be passed when the slot is
free — it is never touched in that branch.

accounts.name: claim
docs: `init` is the idempotency: a second facts submission for the same liquidation cannot create
this twice, so a replayed transaction cannot open a second claim.

accounts.name: payout_backer
docs: decoded and required to hold nothing (A4, applied to the payout rather than the borrower).

accounts.name: revoked
docs: marked this exact (liquidation_record, evidence_hash) pair revoked; never deserialized.

instructions.name: suspend_claim
docs: Admin-only. Freezes a claim: every permissionless progression instruction (`unlock_claim`,
`try_release_queued`, `expire_queued`, `expire_stale`, `claim_stream`) refuses while
suspended.

instructions.name: try_release_queued
docs: Re-checks a `Queued` claim against the current caps and solvency. Permissionless; callable
as often as anyone likes — cash growing or utilisation falling is what lets it through.

instructions.name: unlock_claim
docs: Releases a `PendingTime` claim once the 60-day gate has elapsed, attempting admission at
full value. Permissionless.

instructions.name: unsuspend_claim
docs: Admin-only. Un-freezes a claim, folding the just-ended suspension's duration into
`suspended_secs` so `expire_queued`/`expire_stale` never count time this claim spent
suspended (LOCKED verdict spec: "expiry clocks stop while suspended and reset on
unsuspend").

instructions.name: write_off_inventory
docs: Admin-only, bounded to a market the issuer has actually frozen or halted (E3): the only
case where `buy_inventory` can never clear the position on its own, because the token
account itself is frozen. Zeroes this market's cost basis so deposits/withdrawals can
resume; backers take the loss, same as any other issuer-seizure risk they carry.

types.name: Backer
docs: One backer's stake in the pool.

fields.name: withdraw_shares
docs: Shares queued for exit, and when the queue started. Zero when no exit is pending.

fields.name: verdict_oracle
docs: Throwaway per-chain Ed25519 key. Never the production KMS key.

fields.name: co_signer
docs: Phase 4: the second signer of the 2-of-2 override. Always distinct from `admin` and
`verdict_oracle` (LOCKED verdict spec: "admin ≠ oracle ≠ co-signer, at init and on every
setter"), enforced at `initialize_backstop` and every one of the three setters.

fields.name: cluster_tag
docs: Bound into every signed verdict so a devnet signature can never verify on mainnet.

fields.name: cash
docs: Backer capital actually paid in, tracked internally. Never read from the token account, so a
raw transfer into the vault cannot move the share price (same rule as the lending market).

fields.name: per_claim_cap_bps
docs: Ceiling on a single claim's admission, as a share of cash checked at admission time. A loss
above it never shrinks — it queues until cash grows or utilisation falls enough to admit it.

fields.name: reserved_total
docs: Sum of `loss − streamed` across every `Active` claim. Backers may withdraw `cash −
reserved_total`; a queued or held claim reserves nothing until it is actually admitted.

fields.name: admission_day
docs: Day bucket (`now / DAY_SECS`) the admission counter below is tracking.

fields.name: admitted_today
docs: Cumulative loss admitted so far within `admission_day`.

fields.name: withdraw_delay_secs
docs: Delay between requesting an exit and taking the money.

fields.name: inventory_cost_total
docs: Phase 3 (pool-as-liquidator). Sum of every market's `Inventory.cost_total`: while positive,
`deposit` and `finalize_withdraw` refuse (D4) -- backers cannot buy in cheap right after a
liquidation or exit before a crash-holding is resolved.

fields.name: per_liq_cap_bps
docs: Max share of `cash` a single `pool_liquidate` call may spend.

fields.name: daily_liq_cap_bps
docs: Max share of `cash` `pool_liquidate` may spend across one day, combined.

fields.name: liq_day
docs: Day bucket (`now / DAY_SECS`) `liq_spent_today` is tracking. Separate from the claim
admission day counter -- liquidation draws and claim admissions are different budgets.

fields.name: resale_discount_bps
docs: Resale discount off the healthy price, and how long a fresh acquisition may not be resold
below its own cost (locked: never below cost for the first 4 days).

fields.name: fee_share_bps
docs: Crank fee, as a share of the liquidation bonus the pool captured (D6). Paid to whoever calls
`pool_liquidate`, from cash, after the CPI succeeds.

fields.name: min_pool_repay
docs: Below this, `pool_liquidate` does not fire -- a real liquidation is always well above it; this
only blocks dust-repay fee farming (E6).

fields.name: gate_secs
docs: Phase 5 (A5): admin-settable claim timings, bounded per `cluster_tag` by `set_claim_timing`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for later fields without a migration (U4).

types.name: BadDebtCover
docs: Running total of bad debt the backstop has reimbursed one market for. Makes `cover_bad_debt`
idempotent against the market's own monotonic counter, with no epochs to coordinate.

types.name: BorrowerClaims
docs: One per (market, borrower). Tracks the single live claim slot for that pair — phase 2 keeps one
slot, not the locked spec's separate open+queued pair (see job memory: a second facts submission
while one is unresolved is refused outright rather than queued in parallel).

fields.name: open
docs: `Pubkey::default()` when free. Cleared to the new claim once the occupant is terminal.

fields.name: penalty_since
docs: Phase 4: both set together by `cancel_claim` when a cancelled claim had already started
streaming — `penalty_since` at the cancellation, `penalty_until` 365 days later.
`submit_facts` denies (`deny_reason::PENALTY_ACTIVE`, does not revert) any liquidation whose
debt-weighted `borrow_age_ts` falls inside `[penalty_since, penalty_until)` — "no coverage
on new loans for 365 days" (LOCKED verdict spec), scoped to this exact (market, borrower)
pair. The lower bound matters: without it, a loan opened long before the penalty would
still satisfy `borrow_age_ts < penalty_until` forever, since that bound sits in the future
by construction — an old, already-covered loan must never be caught by a later penalty.

types.name: Claim
docs: One per liquidation. `init` is the idempotency: a second facts submission for the same
liquidation cannot create this twice, so a replayed transaction cannot open a second claim.

fields.name: payout
docs: Frozen at submission from the liquidation record; the eventual payout destination.

fields.name: loss
docs: `safu_core::wrongful_loss`, computed once at submission. Zero on a denied claim.

fields.name: streamed
docs: Cumulative amount actually paid out via `claim_stream`.

fields.name: liquidated_at
docs: When this liquidation happened (`LiquidationRecord.ts`), copied here so later instructions
never need to re-fetch the vault's record.

fields.name: releasable_at
docs: `PendingTime` only: when the 60-day gate clears and `unlock_claim` may be called.

fields.name: admitted_at
docs: `Active` only: when admission happened.

fields.name: snapshot_cash
docs: `cash` at the moment of admission — the outflow cap's floor, so a claim admitted against a
large pool cannot be strangled if the pool later shrinks.

fields.name: last_activity_ts
docs: Updated at admission and at every successful pull. `expire_stale` reads it.

fields.name: suspended
docs: Phase 4 (suspend/unsuspend). While true, every permissionless progression instruction
(`unlock_claim`, `try_release_queued`, `expire_queued`, `expire_stale`, `claim_stream`)
refuses. `suspended_since` is the wall-clock moment suspension began (0 when not
suspended); on `unsuspend_claim` its duration is folded into `suspended_secs`.

fields.name: suspended_secs
docs: Cumulative seconds this claim has ever spent suspended. Subtracted from elapsed time in
`expire_queued`/`expire_stale` so a suspension genuinely freezes those clocks rather than
merely delaying when they are checked (LOCKED verdict spec: "expiry clocks stop while
suspended and reset on unsuspend").

fields.name: vest_origin
docs: Reference point `claim_stream` measures vesting elapsed-time from. Defaults to
`cooldown_end` (identical to reading `cooldown_end` directly) for every ordinary
admission. A 2-of-2 override that carries a prior `streamed` amount forward shifts this
backward by that amount's time-equivalent, so vesting resumes from where it left off
instead of re-streaming the already-paid portion a second time.

fields.name: inactivity_secs
docs: Phase 5: `BackstopConfig.inactivity_secs` copied at admission, so a later change never shortens or
lengthens an already-admitted claim's expiry. The stream length is likewise frozen as
`stream_end − cooldown_end`.

types.name: FactsArgs
docs: The oracle-signed facts (LOCKED verdict spec): a reference price at the liquidation, a reference
price after a wait to prove the move didn't hold, and an evidence hash. No payout amount, no
tier — the program computes and bounds the loss itself from these plus on-chain state.

fields.name: ref_at_liq
docs: USD per whole share, 8 decimals, independent of the feed that liquidated.

fields.name: ref_after
docs: Same reference source, sampled `after_ts`.

fields.name: after_ts
docs: Unix seconds the second sample was taken. Must be `MIN_AFTER_WAIT_SECS..=MAX_AFTER_WAIT_SECS`
after the liquidation.

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: sha256 over the verdict evidence, including the archived reference-price responses.

fields.name: deadline
docs: Unix seconds. The submission must land at or before this time.

types.name: InterestAbsorbed
docs: Running total of interest the pool has recognised from one market, mirroring
`Market.backer_interest_paid_cumulative` so repeat `absorb_interest` calls settle only the
remainder and a raw donation into the USDC vault is never counted (2c pattern, in reverse).

types.name: Inventory
docs: One per market (phase 3). Collateral the pool holds after liquidating through it, priced at cost
until resold. `cost_total` doubles as this market's contribution to `BackstopConfig.inventory_cost_total`
(the deposit/withdraw pause signal, D4) and as the resale floor's basis.

fields.name: raw
docs: Raw collateral currently held.

fields.name: cost_total
docs: USDC the pool paid to acquire what it currently holds. Falls pro-rata to raw sold on resale.

types.name: LiquidationRecord
docs: Immutable snapshot of one liquidation.
The verdict engine decides wrongfulness off-chain, so it must be able to re-derive the decision
from what the contract actually used — not from whatever the feed says later. Every input that
fed the seizure is recorded here, including `issuer_halt` at the time, because a liquidation
taken while the issuer had intervened is excluded from cover (spec 14a).

fields.name: seized_raw
docs: Raw collateral handed to the liquidator.

fields.name: debt_repaid
docs: USDC the liquidator repaid on the borrower's behalf.

fields.name: multiplier_fp
docs: Effective multiplier used for the valuation, in `MULT_SCALE` fixed point.

fields.name: price_fp
docs: TWAP the seizure was priced at, 8 decimals.

fields.name: ltv_bps
docs: Position LTV at the moment of seizure.

fields.name: coverage_bps
docs: Coverage in force for this borrower when the loan was opened (U3).

fields.name: borrow_age_ts
docs: The loan's debt-weighted borrow time at the moment of liquidation (for the 60-day gate).

fields.name: payout
docs: Payback address at the moment of liquidation. Frozen here; later changes cannot redirect it.

fields.name: bad_debt
docs: Debt written off because the collateral ran out, 0 in the normal case.

types.name: LiquidationTerms
docs: The terms that decide when, and how hard, an existing loan is liquidated. Changes that tighten them
ramp in over `LIQUIDATION_TERMS_RAMP_SECS`, so no borrower is liquidated overnight by a number change.

fields.name: cash
docs: USDC held, tracked internally. Never inferred from the vault balance (donation attacks).

fields.name: borrow_index
docs: Debt index, 1.0 == safu_core::lending::INDEX_SCALE.

fields.name: total_collateral_raw
docs: Sum of all positions' raw collateral, for reconciliation against the vault (review D4).

fields.name: bad_debt
docs: Bad debt still uncovered. Falls when the backstop reimburses it.

fields.name: bad_debt_cumulative
docs: Every write-off this market has ever taken, monotonic. The backstop compares its own running
total against this to work out what it still owes, which makes reimbursement idempotent with
no epoch counter to keep in step.

fields.name: observed_multiplier_fp
docs: Effective multiplier this market last acted on, in `MULT_SCALE` fixed point. The baseline the
unannounced-change guard compares the live value against. Seeded by `create_market`; 0 means
"not yet observed", which the guard treats as no change rather than as a change from zero.

fields.name: ramp_from
docs: Where the current liquidation-terms ramp started from, and when (U3). The target is `params`.
Taken from the old 40 reserved bytes (20 + 8), so the account size is unchanged (U4).

fields.name: backer_interest_owed
docs: Interest credited to backers but not yet paid out (eng review addendum). Excluded from
`total_assets`, so lenders' share price reflects only their 85% (2c pattern, in reverse).

fields.name: backer_interest_cumulative
docs: Monotonic total ever credited, mirrored by `InterestAbsorbed.total_absorbed` on the backstop
side so repeat `absorb_interest` calls settle only the remainder.

fields.name: backer_interest_paid_cumulative
docs: Monotonic total ever transferred to the pool via `pay_backer_interest`.

fields.name: issuer_loss_cumulative
docs: Debt written off on positions whose collateral the issuer seized (`write_down_collateral`). Kept apart
from `bad_debt_cumulative` on purpose: the backstop reimburses only that counter, and issuer actions are
never covered (spec 14a) -- lenders carry this loss, as they carry it on every market holding this token.
Taken from the old 12 reserved bytes, so the account size is unchanged (U4).

types.name: MarketParams
docs: Admin-settable within hard bounds (U2). Values and the evidence behind each:
`outputs/2026-09-14_stocklana-market-config-research.md` §2b (research-ops).

fields.name: ltv_bps
docs: Borrowing limit. AAPLx: 4_000 (matched to the market leader).

fields.name: liq_threshold_bps
docs: Liquidation line. AAPLx: 5_000.

fields.name: min_liq_bonus_bps
docs: Dynamic liquidation bonus: max(min, LTV − threshold), capped at max and at 100% − LTV. 100 / 500.

fields.name: insolvency_ltv_bps
docs: Above this LTV the whole debt may be liquidated at once. 9_500.

fields.name: close_factor_bps
docs: Share of debt repayable per liquidation below the insolvency line. 2_500.

fields.name: max_liquidation_debt
docs: USDC base units per liquidation, sized from measured collateral liquidity ($100K).

fields.name: deviation_cap_bps
docs: Single-update spike cap vs TWAP. 500 (US LULD Tier 1 band).

fields.name: activation_pause_secs
docs: Issuer-recommended pause around every multiplier activation. 900 s.

fields.name: split_cap_bps
docs: A multiplier change above this is a split / reverse split. 500.

fields.name: split_max_hold_secs
docs: Longest a split can hold risk actions while waiting for a market-open price. 86_400 s.

fields.name: borrow_max_price_age_secs
docs: Borrow / withdraw need a price at most this old while the market is open. 3_600 s.

fields.name: liquidation_max_price_age_open_secs
docs: Liquidation price age limit while open (feed's own 0.5% / 24h guarantee + 1h). 90_000 s.

fields.name: max_price_age_closed_secs
docs: Any action while the underlying market is closed (longest US closure ≈ 89.5h). 345_600 s.

fields.name: borrow_cap
docs: Total USDC that may be lent (backstop sizing rule, 10:1). Base units.

fields.name: collateral_cap_raw
docs: Total raw collateral accepted.

fields.name: backer_interest_share_bps
docs: Share of accrued borrower interest credited to backers, bounded <= 5_000 (founder-locked at
1_500 = 15%; eng review addendum 2026-09-14). A change applies to interest accrued after it.

types.name: OverrideRequest
docs: One per liquidation (`[OVERRIDE_SEED, liquidation_record]`), opened permissionlessly via
`open_override` ahead of the first `approve_override` call. Mirrors the Soroban
`protection-pool` 2-of-2 pattern: each approver's own current key is recorded, not just "an
approval happened," so a key rotation between the two calls correctly un-readies a stale
approval rather than letting it silently carry over (`approve_override` re-checks against
`BackstopConfig`'s *current* admin/co_signer every call, never a cached value).

fields.name: ref_at_liq
docs: The independently-supplied reference price both approvers must agree on byte-for-byte.

fields.name: executed
docs: Guards against a third call re-executing after both approvals already fired once.

fields.name: prices
docs: Ring buffer, USD per whole share with 8 decimals.

fields.name: head
docs: Next write position.

fields.name: market_open
docs: Whether the underlying equity market was open at the last accepted update.

fields.name: flagged
docs: Set when an update broke the spike cap. Blocks borrowing and liquidation until cleared.

fields.name: flagged_price
docs: The rejected price, so a second consecutive update confirming it can be accepted.

types.name: RevokedAttestation
docs: Marks one specific oracle-signed-but-not-yet-submitted attestation as revoked (admin-only,
`revoke_attestation`). Keyed by `(liquidation_record, evidence_hash)` — the same two fields
that bind every `FactsArgs` payload for that liquidation — so `submit_facts` can refuse a
specific signed message without needing to have seen it yet. Existence alone is the signal:
the fields are stored only for readability off-chain, never re-checked on-chain beyond the
seeds that derived this account.

fields.name: feed_authority
docs: Pushes prices through the mock adapter on devnet. Separate key from the verdict oracle.

fields.name: pool_liquidator
docs: The backstop pool's liquidator key (its config PDA). It may liquidate at once; anyone else only after
the grace period. Default = no pool registered, so the grace rule applies to every liquidator.

fields.name: fallback_grace_secs
docs: How long a position must have been liquidatable before an outside liquidator may act. 900 s.

fields.name: cluster_tag
docs: Which cluster this deployment is on (0 localnet, 1 devnet, 2 mainnet), set once at initialize with no
setter. Selects the time floors (eng review A5): mainnet may never shorten the grace below 5 min.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Taken from the old 64 reserved bytes (32 + 8 + 1), so the account size is unchanged (U4).
